jobs.prompt:

Compute selectors with Crypto.Hash.keccak (NOT hashlib sha3). phase enum: 0 Pending, 1 Minting, 2 AwaitingLaunch, 3 Trading, 4 Refunds. userInfo returns 7 words: id, remaining, freeClaimed, paidShares, bonus, referrer, balance (token balance, 18 decimals).
